title: The Shape of the Doubt: Covariance, the Ellipse It Draws, and Why a Box Around a Position Is the Wrong Shape

questions.question: A position estimate is good to two metres in x and one in y, but x and y move together. What does a box around it lose?
options: The tilt: a box aligned to the axes leaves out the dense corners of the tilted cloud and takes in empty ones, so it holds fewer points in more area
questions.explanation: The box had an area of 32.0 and held 92.9 percent; the ellipse 22.3 and 95.2.

questions.question: What three numbers make a 2D covariance?
options: The variance in x, the variance in y, and the covariance, how much x and y move together

questions.question: For a covariance matrix with xx 2, xy 1, yy 2, what are the eigenvalues and the direction of the long axis?
questions.explanation: The eigenvalues are mean plus or minus a radius.

questions.question: A point 2.2 metres out along the cloud has a squared Mahalanobis distance of 1.00, and one 2.00 metres out across it has 12.38. What does that say about a gate in metres?
options: It accepts the point that is unlikely and rejects the likely one, since an uncertainty is not the same in every direction

questions.question: Why is a point one spread out along an axis of an uncorrelated cloud at a squared distance of exactly 1?
options: The distance is measured in units of the cloud's own spread, so one spread away is 1 whatever the stretch
It is a rule of the language
questions.explanation: A point at (3, 0) against variances 9 and 4 has a squared distance of 1.

questions.question: Ten points lie on a line. What is the squared distance of a point off the line?
options: Infinity: the determinant is zero, there is no inverse, and the cloud has no width across the line
Not defined, so the program crashes
questions.explanation: The centre itself is at distance 0.
